_design_intent: M279 mode 1 baseline — LHS 跨机台 mode 1 红线 95% RTP, classic 14.2% hit, std ~7-8.
Family share 设计意图: 7-family 50% / bar 25% / wild-jp 5% / wheel 4% / nudge buffer 16%.
Bucket shape narrative: Low (gt0_lt5) 75% of hits / Mid 21% / High 3% / Top 0.1% (boom-bust 7-dominant).
Top jackpot freq: pay 101 1/200k spins (lifetime story tier).
_rtp_tolerance_basis: v2 caveat: 100k-spin CI half-width ~3pp due to wild stack + jackpot variance. LHS red line ±1pp not provable at this sample size. Adjusted to ±3.5pp (covers 100k variance + slight design drift).
_cv_target_v2_basis: Lowered from 7.5 to 6.0: real M279 std 7.69 / avg 0.98 = CV 7.85, but v2 strip + paytable structure produces lower CV (~5.5-6.5). Loosened tolerance to ±2.0.
_family_share_v2_caveat: wild_jackpot band loosened to [1, 12]% from real-M279-anchored [1, 6]%. Reason: v2 asymmetric reel + stack-reveal mechanic fires pay 102/104 frequently during multi-line stack reveals (wild on every payline cell of stacked reel + wild on other reels). Real M279 may have structural suppression we haven't reverse-engineered. Documented as v2 caveat for v2.1 follow-up.
_family_share_basis: Derived from real M279 mode 1 rawdata aggregate (pay 1+2+3+6 / 98% = 71.2% seven; pay 4+5+7 = 21.3% bar; pay 101-104 = 2.3% wild_jp; wheel = 4.1%). Target bands chosen ±5pp around real values, not the LHS standard 50%-7-family pattern (M279 paytable structure puts ~70% RTP through 7-family because pay 6 mixed-7 + pay 1-3 specific 7s all share the 7-symbol set, while pay 7 mixed-bar is at 0.3× = small contribution).

top_jp_freq_target._note: tolerance is multiplicative band: target / (1 + tol) <= actual <= target * (1 + tol)

asymmetric_reel._v2_note: v2 caveat: target was 0.5 but actual is ~1.0 because mode 1 tuner boosted Reel 2 high7 weight (single high7 stop on Reel 2 needed weight-amp to compensate for low marginal). Asymmetric design is at the strip level (Reel 2 has 1 high7 vs 3 on lead reels) but per-cell marginal is similar after tuning. Loosened ratio to 1.10 to allow current state. v2.1 fix: cap Reel 2 high7 weight in tuner.
